messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate and missing traces for tenant corp-delta in VPC-prod-eu-west-2. 95th p95 latency spike, traces not appearing in tenant console. Paging oncall.

lina: taking pager — oncall-ingest. Looking at metrics now. Any customer-facing impact?

oncall-eng: seeing 502 spikes from dedicated pool 'dedicated-corp-delta-01'. Errors start ~1800123300. Traces absent in trace-store for that tenant id. Logs coming into cluster, but tenant_id tag missing for many spans.

aj: corp-delta's liaison says they can't see traces or logs in their Kibana. Confirmed via support ticket.

liaison-corpdelta: corp delta SRE here — they report missing traces since ~00:05 UTC. They can still call the API but the console shows empty trace lists. They need visibility for active incidents.

oncall-eng: initial hypothesis: log/tagging extraction step in the VPC forwarder dropped tenant_id header due to egress proxy rewrite. If tenant_id is missing, their trace index filter returns nothing.

sre-miguel: I can check the forwarder config. Diving into the forwarder host in VPC-prod-eu-west-2 now. Will check env vars and sidecar logs.

sec-anya: heads up — corp-delta runs in a private VPC with strict egress. We cannot just enable cross-tenant reads without approval. Any mitigation that touches IAM needs sec signoff.

lina: understood. Short-term mitigation options: 1) create temporary log export for corp-delta spans to an S3 presigned URL we share (read-only), 2) fix forwarder to stop dropping X-Redwood-Tenant header, 3) route corp-delta traffic to fallback pool where tagging works. Which is fastest?

oncall-eng: fastest = export spans for the last 30m to presigned S3 and share with corp-delta. Fixing forwarder might require a redeploy in VPC (30-45m). Routing to fallback pool requires capacity and config change (10-15m if we have spare capacity).

liaison-corpdelta: presigned S3 is fine for now, but SRE will need some near-real-time data. They asked for an ETA on streaming.

aj: I can stand up a temporary stream to s3 + prefix and rotate. Ready to run the export job if we give the tenant_id list.

sre-miguel: found relevant logs: sidecar/nginx on forwarder is rewriting Authorization and a custom lua filter strips headers that don't match a whitelist. X-Redwood-Tenant not whitelisted. Config change would be a 1-line update to whitelist.

oncall-eng: can you patch the config and reload the sidecar without full deploy? If yes, that's ideal — minimal blast radius.

sre-miguel: yes — we can update /etc/forwarder/conf.d/tenant-headers.conf and send SIGHUP to the sidecar. I'll prepare the patch.

sec-anya: need a quick risk note: adding header whitelist entry is low risk, no new privileges. Approve for emergency change in VPC-prod-eu-west-2 for 30m window. :white_check_mark:

prod-alex: coordinating with sales/CS — inform customer this is a visibility-only issue, traffic not dropped. Requesting permission to proceed with header whitelist patch and an S3 export for immediate access.

liaison-corpdelta: corp-delta gives permission for header patch and S3 export. They want an ETA on when traces will reappear.

oncall-eng: plan: (A) run quick export job for last 1h spans to s3://redwood-temp-exports/corpdelta/180012/ (AJ) — ETA 8m; (B) patch forwarder to whitelist X-Redwood-Tenant and reload sidecar (Miguel) — ETA 6m to patch + reload; (C) verify traces reappear in tenant console, then close pager.

aj: kicking off export now. command: 
```
redwood-export --tenant corp-delta --since 1h --out s3://redwood-temp-exports/corpdelta/180012/ --compress
```
Output: started job id job-4587. Estimated time 5m.

sre-miguel: applying patch to /etc/forwarder/conf.d/tenant-headers.conf. patch: 
```
-    whitelist = ["Authorization", "X-Request-Id"]
+    whitelist = ["Authorization", "X-Request-Id", "X-Redwood-Tenant"]
```
Reloading sidecar (SIGHUP) now.

oncall-eng: monitoring trace-store ingestion pipeline for tenant filter hits.

incident-bot: Deploy event: config-change by sre-miguel in VPC-prod-eu-west-2 at 1800123560.

oncall-eng: traces for corp-delta reappearing in trace-store index! p95 latency still a bit high but visibility restored.

liaison-corpdelta: confirmed — corp-delta SRE sees traces and linked spans B3 ids. Thank you. They still want the export for the period where they were blind.

aj: export complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-temp-exports/corpdelta/180012/job-4587.tar.gz (presigned URL shared privately).

prod-alex: sending customer note: "We restored trace visibility by updating a header whitelist in the forwarder. We also generated an export of spans during the affected window. Investigation into why header whitelist changed during the last deploy is next action."

sec-anya: follow-up: we need to ensure config drift doesn't remove X-Redwood-Tenant again. Propose adding integration test and alert if tenant headers missing in incoming spans.

sre-miguel: filing a follow-up ticket to add CI check + automated config sync. I'll attach the patch and logs.

lina: handoff: I'm on for the next 30m for post-change monitoring, then handoff to SRE scheduled 1800126800. If anything resurfaces ping me.

oncall-eng: closing pager in 10m if no regressions. Good work. :tada:

prod-alex: assigning postmortem owner: aj. Expected 72h draft with timeline, root cause, mitigations, and config hardening tasks.

aj: ack. Will start on timeline and include the export artifacts + forwarder diff.

liaison-corpdelta: corp-delta thanks the team. They requested a short runbook entry for future incidents where tenant visibility gaps occur.

lina: noted — will add runbook stub to incidents KB and link in the postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: corp-delta trace visibility restored at 1800123715. Pager status: resolved.
